customer_reply:
Hi Frostline Retail Group team,

Thank you for reaching out. We've identified the cause of error E-2207 on your e-signature requests: an expired integration credential is preventing the e-signature workflow from completing, which is why your two supplier agreements are being rejected immediately.

Here's how to resolve it:
1. Open Admin > Integrations > Credentials.
2. Regenerate the expired credential and update it in your connected e-signature system.
3. Trigger a manual sync and confirm the job status shows "Completed."

Once the credential is refreshed, please re-send the two blocked supplier agreements — they should process normally.

If the issue persists after following these steps, or if more than 50 records become affected, please let us know and we'll escalate to our engineering team. In that case, please have the tenant ID, affected record IDs, exact error text, and time of failure (UTC) ready.

Best regards,
Support Team
internal_note: E-2207 on CLM e-signature for ACC-1633 (Frostline Retail Group, Standard tier). Cause per KB-1786: expired integration credential. 2 contracts affected, single tenant. Resolution is tenant-admin self-service (regenerate credential + manual sync). No L2 escalation needed (<50 records, single tenant). No duplicates in 7-day window. No account risk override (renewal 240d, 0 escalations, stable usage). Route to L1 for guided resolution. If customer reports failure after steps, escalate to L2 with tenant ID, record IDs, error text, UTC time.
